Dark-rimmed rectangular eyeglasses and a striped dark shirt worn by an older adult with a round face shape, high rounded forehead, strongly convex profile, and receding hairline present only at temples and back. The face features thin sparse arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with lids partially obscured by frames, a straight-bridged nose with a bulbous tip and flaring nostrils, and a wide mouth with thin upper lip, fuller lower lip, upturned corners, and visible upper teeth. The skin shows permanent horizontal forehead creases and prominent nasolabial folds.
